# THE MIRROR IMAGES THAT ARE BUILT RATHER THAN COPIED.
#
# .github/image-mirror.txt lists images that exist upstream and are copied
# into the private mirror. The images here exist nowhere upstream: each is
# BUILT from a pinned source and pushed to
#
#   ghcr.io/rcbj/id-proto-debugger/mirror/<mirror path>
#
# by .github/scripts/mirror-builds.sh, so that no build in a test run
# downloads anything or fetches source from GitHub. The Mirror Images
# workflow runs it beside the copy step (weekly refresh, and `missing` at the
# start of every tests.yml run) and holds these packages private too.
#
# Two columns: the mirror path, and where it is built from —
#
#   * a directory in this repository holding a Dockerfile (`./<dir>`), whose
#     downloads are pinned by `ADD --checksum`;
#   * a git build context (`https://...git#<tag>:<dir>`), a release tag of
#     another repository.
#
# Every build is given the mirror's named contexts (one per line of
# image-mirror.txt), so its FROMs resolve against the mirror as well.
# tests/image_mirror_coverage.js reads this list: the compose files may name
# these paths, the companion's tag must be iya-sts's release, and every
# remote ADD in a listed Dockerfile must carry a checksum.
#
# mirror path                            source
shibboleth-idp-dist:4.3.3                ./shibboleth-idp/dist
iya-sts-companion:v1.0.0                 https://github.com/rcbj/iya-sts.git#v1.0.0:companion
